variants.headline: Still in view: party walks out of government
variants.sub: The government has lost the party {party} from its governing arrangement.
variants.body:
The party {party} has walked out of the government. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

Working people need more from parties than a performance of falling out. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: Still in view: a governing partnership breaks
variants.sub: The party {party} has left the colony's government.
variants.body:
The government has lost the party {party} from its governing arrangement. This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event.

Working people need more from parties than a performance of falling out. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: Still in view: departure redraws the question of cooperation
variants.sub: The party {party} has walked out of the government.
variants.body:
The party {party} has left the colony's government. Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point.

Working people need more from parties than a performance of falling out. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
